essence: The practitioner must perform the weapon rites and sun-worship outside that designated space.
The best practitioner should offer thousands of milk-smeared oblations.
After completing self-consecration, the practitioner must feed brahmins.
The practitioner must be fully adorned in red clothing, garland, and unguent.
The practitioner must maintain an ascetic, detached, and contented mode of life.
